accounting.rationale: The paragraph introduces scoped type/parameter mappings and the distinct NONE typing/procedure duties. The exact null/default/inherited interpretations are in p3-p4 and the EXTERNAL alternative is qualified by C899's explicit-interface or explicit-EXTERNAL disjunction. No local runtime classifier is created.
A mapping is scoped; source-file boundaries, use association and contained constructs are not interchangeable scope categories.
The ordinary IMPLICIT route supplies the type of eligible implicitly typed data entities, not all declarations with matching spelling.
Kind and length/type parameters retain R703/R704 and canonical selector/specification-expression restrictions. No numeric kind or real model is assumed.
The data-entity domain and explicit/intrinsic/component/association exceptions remain p4 and5.4.3 owners.
Mapping uses the first letter of the actual entity name. Literal constants, substrings of names and arbitrary expressions do not receive a new mapping.
The null-mapping duty is selected by TYPE or no specifier list, including the empty-parentheses form, not by EXTERNAL alone.
The procedure duty is selected by EXTERNAL and interpreted by C899. A qualifying explicit interface is an alternative to explicit EXTERNAL; NONE(TYPE) alone does not create this duty.

The first sentences define inclusive alphabetic range expansion and give an example. The final sentence separately prohibits repeated letter membership across all IMPLICIT statements in a scope. Only that distinct prose obligation is the new S8.7-001 restriction, not a runtime mapping classifier.
The expansion applies to a range with its two endpoint letters and minus, subject to C898.
Expansion follows the language's alphabetic sequence, not processor character-code arithmetic.
Both endpoint letters and all intervening letters participate in the mapping and overlap calculation.
A range is equivalent to the expanded letter list; this is a source mapping definition, not another independent execution.
A-C versus A,B,C illustrates the definition and supplies no extra required case or processor observation.

The complete paragraph defines letter-to-type/parameter mappings, null mappings and the exact default-versus-host categories. It is not a new S effect with an empty passing run. Source/interface plans remain in the related grammar requirements and need independently adjudicated whole contexts.
Mappings are scoped, not imported merely by a USE statement or shared across unrelated units.
Each of the26letters A through Z has its own mapping entry, subject to the language's case equivalence.
An entry includes both type and applicable type parameters. No default numeric kind code, fixed character encoding or real binary model is supplied.
A mapping may be null. That is a defined absence of implicit typing, not missing metadata that can be defaulted silently into a successful observation.
An ordinary IMPLICIT statement specifies entries for the letters in its actual letter-spec list; unrelated letters retain their applicable defaults.
TYPE in the NONE specifier list selects the null mapping, even when EXTERNAL is also present.
Absence of the implicit-none-spec list includes bare NONE and NONE(); neither is EXTERNAL-only.
The null-mapping route covers all26letters, not just default-integer names or procedure identifiers.
Only an entry not explicitly specified takes the applicable default; a local remapping and an inherited entity's existing type are different.
The source names program units as one default category.5.1/14.2.3 define actual unit kinds; do not silently replace the written category by compiler behavior or a blanket host-inheritance assumption.
An interface body's unspecified-letter default is its own integer/real default, not its host module's null map. IMPORT controls host entities, not automatic copying of the host's implicit map.
The inclusive I,J,K,L,M,N interval maps to default INTEGER in the stated default categories.
Every other alphabet letter maps to default REAL in those categories, without a hard-coded kind number or precision oracle.
The default is the host map, but an otherwise undeclared implicit variable appearing inside BLOCK belongs to its inclusive scope; this is not a new construct declaration.
Internal subprograms inherit the host map for unspecified letters, including null entries, without changing already host-associated entities.
Module subprograms take the host mapping in this rule. A module subprogram, submodule program unit and module procedure interface body must not be identified solely by the word MODULE.

The paragraph defines implicit declaration through the applicable nonnull first-letter map and four exclusions, then requires a prior IMPLICIT or default mapping and finally states FUNCTION-prefix precedence. Only the prior/default obligation becomes S8.7-002; the defining routes remain definitions, not duplicate value effects.
5.4.3 defines data entities, including data objects and function-result data. Procedure-role and function-result-name rules remain separate.
An explicit type declaration is outside this implicit-declaration antecedent; remapping a letter is not a redeclaration of every explicitly typed entity.
Intrinsic functions retain their intrinsic characteristics rather than acquiring a result type from their first letters.
Components retain their explicit defining context. An IMPLICIT map does not supply omitted component declarations.
A use-associated entity retains its established type and parameters; USE does not import a new local implicit mapping.
A host-associated entity keeps its established type even if the inner map differs for that letter. Local identifiers and inaccessible host names follow19.5.1.4.
The eligible implicit data entity acquires the mapped type and parameters from its first letter, not from assigned literal values.
A null entry supplies no implicit declaration. It is not a default REAL fallback or a runtime undefined-value classifier.
The actual explicit type specification in a FUNCTION prefix is the stated overriding route, subject to the function's canonical type/interface rules.
Precedence concerns the function result. RESULT naming and prohibition of also declaring the result type both ways remain15.6.2.2 owners.

The examples illustrate interface defaults, inherited null mapping, host exclusions, local and sibling identities and use-associated procedures. Ellipses and missing definitions prevent treating the fragments as complete runtime witnesses.
EXAMPLE_MODULE's bare NONE gives its own null map.
FUN's interface body can implicitly type I using its own default despite the containing module's NONE.
JFUN inherits the module null map and explicitly declares result and dummy; it is not the interface-body case.
SUB establishes a host COMPLEX C through its mapping and an actual definition.
SUB1's INTEGER(A,C) map governs its new eligible A and CC, not every accessible entity whose name begins C.
The existing C remains host-associated COMPLEX despite the inner C mapping.
The two sibling Z variables have separate identities; equal spelling/default type does not make them the same entity.
SUB3 accesses FUN through USE; that established function differs from implicit local Q and K typing.
Future complete programs need actual procedure definitions, defined actual arguments, interfaces and completion oracles. No call result or data value is inferred from the fragment.
The example starts on PDF142 and continues on PDF143. It illustrates mapping to a type that later becomes inaccessible by its name, not a new permission to use an undefined type or payload.
The actual IMPLICIT TYPE(BLOB)(A) precedes the local type definition; type-declaration-only prior-definition rules are not blindly extended to this mapping statement.
TYPE BLOB and its INTEGER component supply the type identity used by the map.
B has the declared BLOB type. Its declaration alone does not define component payload.
CALL STEVE and CONTAINS are not the end of the example or section; the child body and interpretation on PDF143 are included.
The original continuation closes STEVE and MAIN and explains the retained type identity. It belongs to note2, not a missing paragraph or a separate normative requirement.
INTEGER :: BLOB makes that name identify a child local rather than the host type name.
The inherited A map still denotes the original derived type even though its name is inaccessible locally.
AA is a new implicitly declared local of that mapped type, not an INTEGER chosen by the shadowing identifier.
The assignment's B remains the host object and does not get a new local implicit type.
A future executed witness must initialize B's component before copying/reading it and add real whole-program checks. The printed declaration and ellipses are not an independent value oracle.
The two BLOCKs illustrate that implicit typing does not create independently declared construct variables for the otherwise unqualified NSQP name.
BLOCK does not establish a new default-real/integer scheme independent of its host.
The two separate constructs refer to the same inclusively scoped NSQP, not two automatically shadowing locals.
The scope of the implicit NSQP is subroutine S even when both appearances are only inside BLOCKs.
The shown guards matter to definedness; a complete witness must preserve the definition/use path and must not read NSQP when that definition did not execute.
The floating calculation, ellipses and missing complete driver are not manufactured native evidence or a portable numerical-value requirement.
The fragment contrasts the EXTERNAL-only duty for F and G without requesting null type mapping. Complete definitions/caller state are still absent.
NONE(EXTERNAL) does not independently turn off implicit result typing.
The explicit REAL,EXTERNAL declaration supplies both G's result type and its EXTERNAL route.
The referenced external F lacks the required explicit interface/EXTERNAL route; C899 owns that numbered restriction.
G illustrates the admitted declaration route, not evidence that its body, values or interface consistency have been tested.
Future diagnostics require complete matching external definitions and otherwise valid calls. Missing libraries/interfaces or undefined Y are not the intended violation.

requirements.title: IMPLICIT has a typed-list form and a NONE form with independently optional parentheses and specifiers
requirements.definition: The ordinary form has a nonempty implicit-spec list. The alternative is IMPLICIT NONE with optional parentheses that themselves may contain an implicit-none-spec list or be empty. NONE, NONE(), NONE(TYPE), NONE(EXTERNAL) and a distinct TYPE/EXTERNAL pair have separate grammatical and semantic premises. The ordinary type map and EXTERNAL duty are not interchangeable; the governing C895-C899 and p3-p4 interpretations remain explicit.

pending.ordinary-typed-list: PENDING complete ordinary program units with IMPLICIT INTEGER(A-H), REAL(O-Z), keeping nonoverlapping letters and legal statement order. Each implicit-spec has its own R867 letter list. These are compile admissions or finite source relations, not empty passing runtime classifiers; actual type-use observations require a complete typed interface or a meaningful defined-data parent.
pending.plain-NONE: PENDING a complete bare IMPLICIT NONE control whose actual data entities and function results are explicitly typed. This supplies a null type map, not the EXTERNAL-only obligation. Use complete ordinary scalar external-call contexts to distinguish C899's false antecedent without violating separate8.5.9 actual-procedure-argument duties.
pending.EXTERNAL-only-NONE: PENDING a complete unit with NONE(EXTERNAL), correctly declared external/interface routes, and eligible data entities using default or separately specified ordinary implicit mappings. Place NONE before other mapping statements in initial controls, respecting the original ordering table and C895. No null type map is inferred from the word NONE alone.
pending.combined-NONE-specifiers: PENDING the two distinct orders NONE(TYPE,EXTERNAL) and NONE(EXTERNAL,TYPE) in complete controls. Both duties apply, but this is one NONE statement. Duplicate keywords are C896, and splitting the duties across two NONE statements invokes C895/C897 instead of an equivalent spelling.

Also distinguish bare IMPLICIT without an implicit-spec from admitted NONE(). R401 list expansion does not itself impose a two-item maximum; the two-keyword domain and C896 supply that consequence. Calibrate actual causes/origins, not generic EOF or source-echo wording.

A repaired lexical occurrence, a TYPEOF operand and a source map are not automatically the same facet or new execution. Existing DATA and PARAMETER typing restrictions remain S8.6.7-002/S8.6.11-001. Current source-only registration adopts no cases, links or SourceUses.

requirements.title: IMPLICIT NONE precedes PARAMETER statements and occurs at most once per scope
requirements.definition: Any IMPLICIT NONE statement in a scoping unit precedes every PARAMETER statement there, and no more than one IMPLICIT NONE appears in that scope. The rule applies to all NONE forms, including EXTERNAL-only and empty parentheses. PARAMETER statement is a specific category; the broader ordering grammar still governs declaration attr-specs and other specification constructs.

R504-R506/Table5.1 and R854/S8.6.11-001 remain explicit owners; actual statement-order cause attribution must be independently checked.

requirements.title: A letter range has a strictly alphabetically later second endpoint
requirements.definition: When the minus and second letter are present, the second letter follows the first alphabetically. Equal endpoints and reverse ranges are not the admitted range form. A single letter has no second-endpoint obligation, and letter case equivalence does not create a different alphabet.

requirements.title: NONE(EXTERNAL) requires an explicit interface or explicit EXTERNAL for the stated procedure scopes
requirements.definition: With the EXTERNAL NONE specifier, an external or dummy procedure name in that scoping unit, a contained subprogram or a BLOCK construct has an explicit interface or is explicitly declared EXTERNAL. The two routes are alternatives. Data type declaration alone is not EXTERNAL, and the condition is not selected by NONE(TYPE) or bare NONE alone. Actual procedure/result/data roles and the separate interface obligations remain canonical.

pending.procedure-declaration-route: PENDING complete PROCEDURE(iface) and qualified PROCEDURE(REAL) contexts under15.4.3.6. requirements.title: A letter belongs to at most one implicit specification in a scoping unit
requirements.definition: The same letter is not specified as a singleton or included in a range more than once across all IMPLICIT statements in one scoping unit. Inclusive expansion and case equivalence are applied before checking membership. Equal type/kind/length mappings do not make duplicate specification permitted. This is a prose restriction separate from C898 and the NONE cardinality rules.

pending.overlapping-ranges: PENDING inclusive source-membership relations for A-C with C-E and for a singleton B combined with A-C, keeping both ranges individually ascending. No NONE statement is included, so C895/C897 do not manufacture a different predicate. Exact reporting remains optional evidence under this prose owner, not compulsory fatal behavior.
pending.identical-mapping-not-exempt: PENDING source contrasts where repeated membership has the same type and parameters versus different mappings. The rule excludes both; it is not merely contradictory types or last-wins semantics. Do not execute invalid mappings to invent a deterministic type/value oracle.
pending.distinct-scope-and-unmentioned-defaults: PENDING complete parent/sibling/interface scopes with their own nonoverlapping local lists, and partial maps leaving other letters at their appropriate defaults. An inherited default is not another written letter-spec in the child. Exact3.120/p3/p4 role boundaries precede any finite relation, and no source-graph approval is implied.
